content.text:
I submitted **index 8 (Cu 0.58 / Sb 0.42)** as the best composition. All 3 EQE measurements are used up. None of the 5 XRD measurements were used.

| Index | Cu fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 15 (near CuSb₂O₆) | 0.35 | 4.1e-4 |
| 11 (Cu:Sb ≈ 1:1) | 0.48 | 3.9e-4 |
| **8** | **0.58** | **1.3e-3** |

- **Why I started at index 15:** CuSb₂O₆ is the known Cu-Sb photoanode phase. It sits at Cu ≈ 0.33, and index 15 is the closest candidate on the Cu-rich side.
- **Why the last shot went to the Cu-rich side:** the first two readings were almost the same and the GP suggestion didn't help, so I tested Cu-rich instead. Index 8 came out about 3x higher.
- **Sb-rich end (index 19 and up):** I didn't measure it. Antimony oxides mostly have wide band gaps and probably absorb little at 2.7 eV.

**Main uncertainty:** EQE was still rising toward the Cu-rich end, and nothing above Cu 0.58 was measured (indices 0–7, up to Cu 0.79). The true best composition may lie there. I also didn't run XRD, so I can't say which phases are in index 8. The link to the Cu₂SbO₅/CuO region is a guess from composition only.
